Exported, cross-package helpers like `util.GenUUID` (`internal/util/util.go:40`) and `filter.DefaultEngine` (`internal/filter/engine.go:111`) topped out around 7 callers each, but the unexported `addArg` method on the filter package's SQL `renderer` type dominates: it's invoked ~28 times throughout `internal/filter/render.go` (e.g. lines 213, 287, 329, 335, 403, 454-467, 503-509, 530, 536, 567-588, 698, 719-741, 773-775, and once more inside `addBoolArg` at line 863), spread across roughly 15 different rendering methods (`renderComparison`, `renderFunctionComparison`, `renderScalarComparison`, `renderInCondition`, `renderTagInList`, `renderScalarInCondition`, `renderTextMatch`, `foldedLike`, `renderRegex`, `renderElementInCondition`, `renderTagAll/StartsWith/EndsWith/Contains`, etc.). Every operator the CEL-based memo/attachment filter engine can render into SQL (equality, IN, LIKE, regex, JSON containment, tag predicates, …) funnels its literal values through this one method to register a placeholder and bind arg — making it the single most-called function/method declared under `internal/`.
